name: Wren Ashby
description: Seventeen, apprentice ferry pilot of Saltmere: quick with knots, curious about everything on the water.

knot_work.label: Knot work
knot_work.description: Wren ties any knot fast and can tell a bad splice by touch.
knot_work.limits: Only ropes and nets within reach.

tide_sense.label: Tide sense
tide_sense.description: Reads the water and tells where a current will push a boat in the next hour.
tide_sense.limits: Only on water Wren has rowed before; useless in thick fog.

second_wind.label: Second wind
second_wind.description: A burst of strength that lets Wren row or haul far beyond normal limits for a few minutes.
second_wind.limits: Costs mana; requires a conscious effort.
